questions.q: An aquatic plant is put in hydrogencarbonate indicator in bright light. What colour does the indicator become?
questions.why: Photosynthesis is faster than respiration, so CO₂ is taken up and the indicator turns purple.
Phloem carries sucrose and amino acids; xylem carries water and mineral ions.

questions.q: Which change increases the rate of transpiration?
questions.why: Wind removes water vapour near the leaf, keeping a steep diffusion gradient out of the stomata.

questions.q: Describe how water is lost from a leaf in transpiration.
questions.model: Water evaporates from the surfaces of the mesophyll cells into the air spaces, then diffuses out of the leaf through the stomata as water vapour.
points: evaporates from mesophyll cell surfaces into air spaces
